classification: source-route caveat and anti-regression support only

files.publication_status: source-route caveat/support packet only; do not front above reader artifacts

scope: R247 clarifies the valid and invalid source routes for Noether Papers 15 and 16 against the current R225 German base. It carries current R225 anchor extracts, compact source witnesses, resolution ledgers, old-route warnings, and prior applied-fix/no-fix ledgers.
result: No TeX patch. R228 already showed that the known P15 x-index and Schur citation repairs and the P16 F-not-Phi repair survive in R225. R247 prevents stale or offset P15/P16 source routes from being reused as authority.
quality_caveat: P15's old article PDF embeds 360ppi main-layer page images plus a 120ppi layer; a separate title-page witness is 400ppi. P16's old article PDF embeds 360/120ppi page images; corrected GDZ comparators are 400ppi and IA pages have larger pixels but undefined native DPI. Old 1000dpi-labelled crops are enlarged known-locus witnesses only, not native 1000ppi authority. Do not claim strict 650+ P15/P16 page-by-page certification from this packet.
recommended_action: Preserve current P15/P16 R225 TeX, do not replay old P15/P16 fixes over R225, do not use the bad-offset P16 GDZ canvases 00000025-00000030, and use R170-valid P16 IA leaves 0028-0033 or GDZ canvases 31-36 if visual rechecking is needed.
specific_traps: P15 printed p152: keep Latin x indices, not Greek chi/kappa.
P15 printed p154: keep Schur citation S. 355, not S. 555.
P16 printed p30: keep prose 'aus F und aus Formen aus M', not Phi.
